plugins.name: multi-expert-debate
plugins.description: Structured multi-expert debate: triage the question, convene 3-12 experts with opposing perspectives, run adversarial debate rounds, and synthesize an actionable conclusion.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 多专家辩论技能：先 Triage 判断问题复杂度，再召集 3-12 位立场互补甚至对立的虚拟专家，做结构化分析、正面对抗辩论，最后收敛为可执行的综合结论。
